raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the task from the outset by treating “the city the winner is from” as the winner’s birthplace (Omaha) instead of his commonly cited hometown/residence (Austin). This misalignment led the workflow to test whether Omaha was ever the capital of Texas and conclude “no year,” rather than identifying Austin and determining when it became Texas’s capital (1839). The Planner later compounded the confusion by conflating “capitol” (building) with “capital” (seat of government), but the root cause originated in Step 0’s incorrect task framing.
